sources.snippet: What is Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507? Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 is a 4 billion parameter reasoning model from the Qwen team, an updated build of the Qwen3-4B thinking variant published on Hugging Face on August 5, 2025.
